notes: Top-down layered human. Every layer faces UP at rotation 0 and shares one 33x33 frame; rotate about pivot. Anchors are source px from the frame top-left. Outfit pixels are neutral grey in the base PNG and white in *_color.png: multiply by the outfit colour there. No baked shadow: draw a 1px down-right shadow from the final silhouette. Rotation: quarter turns are lossless; for other angles nearest works, or pre-render 32 rotations (reference: art/_src/compose.py).

legs.notes: frames 0 and 3 are the contacts; the swing boot (frames 1-2 right, 4-5 left) is lighter

arms.notes: item placement: item top-left = mount - item.grip (both unrotated), then rotate the upper group about the pivot. Use pose "pistol" for pistols, "rifle" for rifles, "tool" for the wrench and extinguisher, "heavy" for heavy guns, "melee" for blades and hammers (an item JSON's "class" names its pose).

head.notes: hair is not tinted; the helmet shell takes the outfit colour, its visor and glint stay as drawn
